info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Competitor Reviews Submission API
info.description: The Competitor Reviews Submission API allows businesses to submit reviews related to competitor activities. This endpoint is designed for companies to gather insights and feedback on competitor products or services by sending detailed review data. Typical consumers include market analysts and business development teams seeking to understand competitive positioning. Users can leverage this information to inform strategic decisions and enhance market strategies.

post.summary: Submit a review for a competitor analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit reviews related to a specific competitor analysis. Ensure that all required fields are filled out correctly to enhance the quality of the feedback.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit reviews for the competitor analysis with the ID RES-100045. It requires a JSON object containing the review details, as defined in the schema.
